npcs.name: Dr. Helena Crowe
npcs.secret: She has been experimenting on herself.
npcs.motivation: To prove her theories on extradimensional biology.
npcs.bio: A celebrated surgeon whose recent behavior has become detached from reality.

npcs.name: Jonas Merrick
npcs.secret: He witnessed a ritual in the woods as a child.
npcs.motivation: To prevent it from happening again.
npcs.bio: A local mechanic with a thousand-yard stare.

npcs.name: Marigold Finch
npcs.secret: Knows she is losing time—waking up in new places.
npcs.personality: Kind, dreamy, frightened beneath the surface.
npcs.bio: The town librarian with cryptic blackout episodes.

npcs.name: Deputy Mason Rourke
npcs.secret: Is covering up evidence of a creature sighting.
npcs.motivation: To protect the town from panic.
npcs.bio: A loyal lawman who has seen too much.

npcs.name: Sister Abigail Holt
npcs.secret: Her visions may not be divine.
npcs.motivation: To follow what she believes is a holy command.
npcs.bio: A nun who claims to speak with angels.

npcs.name: Elias Brine
npcs.secret: Knows the true name of the entity haunting the woods.
npcs.motivation: To avoid being found by it.
npcs.bio: Once a professor—now a paranoid hermit.

npcs.name: Vivienne Sable
npcs.secret: She’s been dead for three days, though she doesn’t know it.
npcs.motivation: To find out why no one seems to notice.
npcs.bio: A socialite whose reality is thin around the edges.

npcs.name: Harold Pike
npcs.secret: He’s been dreaming events before they happen.
npcs.motivation: To prevent one specific dream from coming true.
npcs.bio: A humble mailman with prophetic nightmares.

npcs.name: Selene Ward
npcs.secret: She is possessed by a second consciousness.
npcs.motivation: To keep the other mind from taking full control.
npcs.bio: A college student battling an unseen intruder in her mind.

npcs.name: Captain Rowan Fisk
npcs.secret: Smuggles occult artifacts for wealthy collectors.
npcs.motivation: To make enough money to disappear.
npcs.bio: A salvage ship captain with a dangerous side hustle.
